source_units.text: Write an opening proposal for a fictional barter exchange.
Use a courteous and open voice.
Keep the complete piece to 55–85 words.
Use this fictional material: The speaker offers two woven baskets in exchange for one lamp repair.
Suggest Sunday afternoon for the exchange, and make clear the other person can propose a different arrangement.
Required wording, verbatim: "two woven baskets", "one lamp repair", "Sunday afternoon".
Use wording suitable for the other participant in a fictional neighborhood exchange.
